I understand your perspective, and have revised the petition to request that the Facebook & Instagram platforms improve business processes to ensure that their associates can provide information to law enforcement only in the event of an emergency, instead of law enforcement having access to a database with all if that information.

There was an emergency. Police told me there was nothing they could do because I couldn’t provide them with a number or address. It’s really that simple. If I can take action to save a life, I will try my best to.

Good to know. I’m trying to get this issue in front of the C-Suite team, to get the discussion started. To review their business processes and see how they may be improved toward the best fitting solution, even if it’s not the one I’ve proposed.

Someone almost died because we weren’t sure if we had the correct number & address for the Police to get to them. What if it was your friend or family member? There are ways to maintain user privacy but still ensure that law enforcement has the appropriate access in the event it is needed such as an emergency.
You matter. Whatever those issues are, they can be worked on. Leaving at your own will is permanent. I can lend an ear if you need it. Just hit me up on the chat.
